statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low with mean reversion functioning, while Stress stays elevated on 24-year-high Treasury yields and an unresolved Middle East shipping disruption.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the mapped state is unchanged. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers the 18:00Z FOMC minutes release and the following hour of potential delayed repricing.
headline: Record Nasdaq-100 close fades from its high as a quiet overnight range keeps Tail low before the FOMC minutes
body: NQ December futures trade near 31,466 after a narrow 31,431-31,521 overnight range that is two-sided and mid-range, showing no directional efficiency. The Nasdaq-100 closed at a record 31,224.69, up 0.48%, but gave back roughly 137 points from its 31,361.37 intraday high, so retracement is intact rather than failing. VIX near 15.0 is down about 3% with no volatility expansion. The dominant tension is macro rather than path based: the 10-year Treasury yield is steady around 5.31% near a 24-year high, with the 30-year near 5.65%, pressured by energy-driven inflation, fiscal deficits and AI-related issuance. Brent near 101.5 and WTI near 90.2 have recovered from five-week lows as attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continue, with crude transiting the strait sharply reduced. Equities at record highs alongside these conditions represent a conflict that raises Stress and gap risk rather than observed Tail. Semiconductor leadership was broad in the prior session. The FOMC minutes from the September 15-16 dot-plot meeting arrive at 18:00Z and are the window's main multi-stage checkpoint, preceded by a 10-year note auction near 17:00Z.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours of published Claude assessments stayed in the mapped EA_ON state apart from two WATCH hours around 15:00Z and 16:00Z on 6 October, when Tail briefly reached 22 during the U.S. cash session. Tail then decayed from the high teens back to 10-11 through the evening and Asian hours as the index faded from its intraday high, while Stress held in a narrow 45-48 band throughout.
outlookSummary: Tail is expected to stay in the low band through the European morning on a balanced overnight range, then rise modestly into the U.S. cash open and the afternoon yield sequence. The 10-year note auction near 17:00Z and the FOMC minutes at 18:00Z form the window's risk concentration, with conditional Tail peaking at 22 in the 19:00Z delayed-repricing and power-hour slot before decaying back to the window floor through the evening and Asian session. Stress stays elevated throughout on 24-year-high yields, oil above 100 Brent and unresolved Hormuz shipping disruption.
